entries.notes: Implemented without a new engine path: exclusive place interactions (return the clasp = item cost -> stores; force = fewer stores + 3 damage) plus an item (relay clasp) that links two fixed sites. Keep = never return it and equip the clasp. Atomic cost/award/receipt reuses LocationRuntime. Awaiting approval and playtest.
